name: Amelia Williams
source:
Aunt to the main character and Catherine. Daughter of Allison. Sister to Elizabeth.

Amy works as the makeup artist of the singer Elaine (Amy and Elaine are also personal friends) and is often on tour with her. Since she is seldom home, she does not maintain her own home but stays with Allison (and MC) when she has some downtime. 

Amy has trained Krav Maga for more than twenty years and is a Blue belt.

She is the only one to find the main character's constant sleeping around to be questionable and is often astonished when yet another "conquest" is revealed. She especially disapproves of the sexual relations that MC has with Liz (her sister) and Cat (her niece). (And also that [i]both[/i] call MC "Daddy", which she finds beyond weird.)

[spoiler]While out celebrating her 16th birthday, Amy was assaulted by a gang and very nearly gang-raped. If not for the intervention of Elaine (this became the start of their friendship) and her skill in Krav Maga, she would have been. It was severely traumatising for the young Amy and more than twenty years later Amy is still unable to tolerate male touch. The only exception is the MC. (Despite him now being an obviously grown man, she still doesn't fully think of him as a "Man" in that sense, he is just her nephew and thus safe.)[/spoiler]
